 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Admin as Admin (UI Panel)
 participant SA as Server Action (featured.action.js)
 participant FS as Firestore Database
 participant Cache as Next.js Cache (revalidatePath)
 actor User as Normal User (Home UI)

 Admin->>SA: Submit Form (addFeaturedItem) or Click Delete
 Note over SA: Secure Execution in Server Context
 SA->>FS: db.collection(\"featured_items\").add() / delete()
 FS-->>SA: Database Updated Successfully
 SA->>Cache: revalidatePath(\"/\") (Invalidate Cache)
 SA-->>Admin: Return { success: true }
 Note over Admin: Toast notification pops up & reload state
 
 Note over User: Next visit or Refresh
 User->>SA: Request Page /
 SA->>FS: getFeaturedItems() (Fresh read)
 FS-->>User: Render updated UI to User

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor User as Frontend User
 participant FE as Frontend (Next.js)
 participant BE as FastAPI Server (api.py)
 participant Parser as Resume Parser
 participant LLM as LLM/Gemini Engine

 %% Step 1: Parse
 User->>FE: Upload Resume (.pdf)
 FE->>BE: POST /parse (Multipart Form)
 Note over BE,Parser: Saves temp PDF & extracts raw text
 BE->>Parser: parse_resume(pdf_path)
 Parser-->>BE: parsedResume Data
 BE-->>FE: Return parsedResume & rawText

 %% Step 2 (Parallel Fan-out)
 rect rgb(30, 41, 59)
 Note over FE,BE: Step 2a: Calculate ATS Score & Step 2b: Generate Qns (Runs in parallel)
 FE->>BE: POST /ats-score (parsedResume, jobDescription)
 BE->>LLM: Score Resume vs JD
 LLM-->>BE: ATS Scores
 BE-->>FE: Return atsResult (Scores)

 FE->>BE: POST /generate-questions (parsedResume, focusArea, etc.)
 BE->>LLM: Generate verification questions
 LLM-->>BE: Questions Array
 BE-->>FE: Return verificationQuestions
 end

 %% Step 3 (Downstream of atsResult)
 rect rgb(15, 23, 42)
 Note over FE,BE: Step 3a: Feedback & Step 3b: Resume Optimization
 FE->>BE: POST /feedback (atsResult, jobDescription)
 BE->>LLM: Generate ATS feedback report
 LLM-->>BE: Feedback Text
 BE-->>FE: Return feedback

 FE->>BE: POST /optimize-resume (parsedResume, atsResult)
 BE->>LLM: Generate optimized content modifications
 LLM-->>BE: Optimized Resume JSON
 BE-->>FE: Return optimizedResume
 end

 FE->>User: Display Interview Questions, ATS Score, Feedback & Suggestions
